<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">JWT Authentication (Required for Advanced Features)</h3><a id="user-content-jwt-authentication-required-for-advanced-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: JWT Authentication (Required for Advanced Features)" href="#jwt-authentication-required-for-advanced-features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Some endpoints require JWT authentication (expires every 5 minutes):</strong></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ruby notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c"># Authenticate to get JWT token</span>
<span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">authenticate</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span>
  <span class="pl-pds">email</span>: <span class="pl-s">'your_email@example.com'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-pds">password</span>: <span class="pl-s">'your_password'</span>
<span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-c"># Token is automatically stored and injected in subsequent requests</span>

<span class="pl-c"># Check token status</span>
<span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">jwt_expired?</span> <span class="pl-c"># => false</span>
<span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">jwt_time_remaining</span> <span class="pl-c"># => 287 (seconds)</span>

<span class="pl-c"># JWT is required for these endpoints:</span>
<span class="pl-c"># - Mass Payouts (create_payout, verify_payout, list_payouts)</span>
<span class="pl-c"># - Conversions (create_conversion, conversion_status, list_conversions)</span>
<span class="pl-c"># - Custody Operations (transfer_between_sub_accounts, write_off_sub_account_balance)</span>
<span class="pl-c"># - Recurring Payments (delete_recurring_payment)</span>

<span class="pl-c"># Example: Create payout (requires JWT)</span>
<span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">authenticate</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-pds">email</span>: <span class="pl-s">'your@email.com'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-pds">password</span>: <span class="pl-s">'password'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">payout</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">create_payout</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span>
  <span class="pl-pds">withdrawals</span>: <span class="pl-kos">[</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
      <span class="pl-pds">address</span>: <span class="pl-s">'TEmGwPeRTPiLFLVfBxXkSP91yc5GMNQhfS'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
      <span class="pl-pds">currency</span>: <span class="pl-s">'trx'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
      <span class="pl-pds">amount</span>: <span class="pl-c1">10</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-pds">payout_description</span>: <span class="pl-s">'Weekly payouts'</span>
<span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c"># Verify payout with 2FA code (from Google Authenticator)</span>
<span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">verify_payout</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span>
  <span class="pl-pds">batch_withdrawal_id</span>: <span class="pl-s1">payout</span><span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-s">'id'</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-pds">verification_code</span>: <span class="pl-s">'123456'</span>
<span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c"># Token auto-refresh pattern</span>
<span class="pl-k">def</span> <span class="pl-en">ensure_authenticated</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">client</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">email</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">password</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
  <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-k">unless</span> <span class="pl-s1">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">jwt_expired?</span>
  <span class="pl-s1">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">authenticate</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-pds">email</span>: <span class="pl-s1">email</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-pds">password</span>: <span class="pl-s1">password</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-k">end</span>

<span class="pl-c"># Before JWT-required operations</span>
<span class="pl-en">ensure_authenticated</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">EMAIL</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-c1">PASSWORD</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-s1">payouts</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">list_payouts</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-pds">limit</span>: <span class="pl-c1">10</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-pds">offset</span>: <span class="pl-c1">0</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c"># Clear token when done (optional, for security)</span>
<span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">clear_jwt_token</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="# Authenticate to get JWT token
client.authenticate(
  email: 'your_email@example.com',
  password: 'your_password'
)
# Token is automatically stored and injected in subsequent requests

# Check token status
client.jwt_expired? # => false
client.jwt_time_remaining # => 287 (seconds)

# JWT is required for these endpoints:
# - Mass Payouts (create_payout, verify_payout, list_payouts)
# - Conversions (create_conversion, conversion_status, list_conversions)
# - Custody Operations (transfer_between_sub_accounts, write_off_sub_account_balance)
# - Recurring Payments (delete_recurring_payment)

# Example: Create payout (requires JWT)
client.authenticate(email: 'your@email.com', password: 'password')
payout = client.create_payout(
  withdrawals: [
    {
      address: 'TEmGwPeRTPiLFLVfBxXkSP91yc5GMNQhfS',
      currency: 'trx',
      amount: 10
    }
  ],
  payout_description: 'Weekly payouts'
)

# Verify payout with 2FA code (from Google Authenticator)
client.verify_payout(
  batch_withdrawal_id: payout['id'],
  verification_code: '123456'
)

# Token auto-refresh pattern
def ensure_authenticated(client, email, password)
  return unless client.jwt_expired?
  client.authenticate(email: email, password: password)
end

# Before JWT-required operations
ensure_authenticated(client, EMAIL, PASSWORD)
payouts = client.list_payouts(limit: 10, offset: 0)

# Clear token when done (optional, for security)
client.clear_jwt_token" tabindex="0" role="button">

<div class="highlight highlight-source-ruby notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c"># Authenticate first</span>
<span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">authenticate</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-pds">email</span>: <span class="pl-s">'your@email.com'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-pds">password</span>: <span class="pl-s">'password'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c"># List all conversions</span>

<p dir="auto"><strong>Withdraw cryptocurrency to fiat bank accounts:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ruby notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c"># Authenticate first</span>
<span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">authenticate</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-pds">email</span>: <span class="pl-s">'your@email.com'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-pds">password</span>: <span class="pl-s">'password'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

<span class="pl-c"># Get available payment methods</span>
<span class="pl-s1">methods</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">fiat_payout_payment_methods</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-pds">fiat_currency</span>: <span class="pl-s">'EUR'</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-c"># => {"result" => [{"provider" => "transfi", "methods" => [...]}]}</span>

<span class="pl-c"># Create payout account</span>
<span class="pl-s1">account</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">client</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">create_fiat_payout_account</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span>
  <span class="pl-pds">provider</span>: <span class="pl-s">'transfi'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-pds">fiat_currency</span>: <span class="pl-s">'EUR'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-pds">account_data</span>: <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-pds">accountHolderName</span>: <span class="pl-s">'John Doe'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
    <span class="pl-pds">iban</span>: <span class="pl-s">'DE89370400440532013000'</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span>

    <span class="pl-kos">)</span>
    
    <span class="pl-c"># Process payment status</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">order</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-v">Order</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">find_by</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-pds">id</span>: <span class="pl-s1">payload</span><span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-s">'order_id'</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>

    <span class="pl-k">when</span> <span class="pl-s">'finished'</span>
      <span class="pl-s1">order</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">mark_paid!</span>
      <span class="pl-v">OrderMailer</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">payment_received</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">order</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">deliver_later</span>
    <span class="pl-k">when</span> <span class="pl-s">'failed'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s">'expired'</span>
      <span class="pl-s1">order</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">cancel!</span>

    <span class="pl-k">end</span>
    
    <span class="pl-en">head</span> <span class="pl-pds">:ok</span>
    
  <span class="pl-k">rescue</span> <span class="pl-v">NOWPayments</span>::<span class="pl-v">SecurityError</span> <span class="pl-c1">=></span> <span class="pl-en">e</span>

<span class="pl-en">post</span> <span class="pl-s">'/webhooks/nowpayments'</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-pds">to</span>: <span class="pl-s">'webhooks#nowpayments'</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

class WebhooksController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  
  def nowpayments
    # Verify signature - raises SecurityError if invalid
    payload = NOWPayments::Rack.verify_webhook(
      request,
      ENV['NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET']
    )
    
    # Process payment status
    order = Order.find_by(id: payload['order_id'])
    
    case payload['payment_status']
    when 'finished'
      order.mark_paid!
      OrderMailer.payment_received(order).deliver_later
    when 'failed', 'expired'
      order.cancel!
    when 'partially_paid'
      # Customer sent wrong amount
      logger.warn "Underpaid: #{payload['actually_paid']} vs #{payload['pay_amount']}"
    end
    
    head :ok
    
  rescue NOWPayments::SecurityError => e
    logger.error "Invalid webhook signature: #{e.message}"
    head :forbidden
  end
end
